title: Geometry Unit 1 Pretest
purpose: Diagnostic assessment for prior knowledge, readiness, and acceleration eligibility.

primaryStandards.description: I can construct a copy of a segment or an angle using geometric tools.
I can construct segment bisectors, angle bisectors, and perpendicular bisectors.
I can prove and apply relationships involving lines, angles, and angle pairs.
I can interpret conditional statements and identify converse, inverse, and contrapositive statements.
I can construct valid geometric proofs, including proofs by contradiction.
I can evaluate arguments and use counterexamples to disprove false statements.
